boon.description: On his next turn, the target suffers 1 fatigue for each manoeuvre he performs.

bane.description: All characters, friend or foe, within close range of the target suffer 1 fatigue as grasping vines tear at them.

chaosStar.description: This spell affects another target within range of the GM's choice.

conservative.requirements: Target must be within medium range depending on natural earth or near greenery. Effect: Vines, roots, and other growing things burst from the ground and wrap around your target. While this spell is recharging, he must pass an Average (2d) Athletics check to move, and gains the condition.

success.description: As above, and you may affect a second target within close range of the first.

bane.description: All characters, friend or foe, within close range of the target suffer 1 fatigue as grasping vines tear at them.

chaosStar.description: This spell affects another target within range of the GM's choice.

reckless.requirements: 4 power. Target must be within medium range and stand on natural earth or near greenery. Effect: Vines, roots, and other growing things burst from the ground and wrap around your target. While this spell is recharging, he must pass an Average (2d) Athletics check to move and gains the Exposed condition.
